title: Unpointed etale algebra model at a prime
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and p a prime of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let alpha : R_p to B be a ring map whose map of spectra is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. There exist a commutative ring C, maps a : R to C and i : C to B, and a submonoid M of C, such that Spec(a) is etale, a followed by i equals the composite R to R_p to B, and B is an M-localization of C for the algebra structure induced by i. No field-valued pointing is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Tags 01ZM, 07RP, 01Z6, 00CR and 00CP; unpointed affine descent and localization identification in the parent proof

proof.text: Write R_p as the filtered colimit of the principal localizations R_s, indexed by finite subsets of R minus p (00CR; CommRingCat.isColimitAwayProdCocone). Apply etale_finite_data_descent to Spec B over Spec R_p to obtain a finite-presentation etale scheme at a principal stage.

The transition morphisms of the descended schemes are affine and the limit is Spec B. Apply Mathlib Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit (01Z6), and replace the stage by a later affine stage Spec C. Compose its etale map to Spec R_s with the etale principal open immersion into Spec R to obtain a : R to C.

The base-change isomorphism yields i : C to B and the structure equation. Let M be the image under a of R minus p. The universal property of localization (00CP) identifies the base change with M inverse C; transport IsLocalization to B under the isomorphism, using the C-algebra structure induced by i.

A finitely presented etale algebra over a localization at a prime is the localization of an etale algebra over the original ring
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.exists_etale_of_isEtaleAt, Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway and localization-span results. None constructs a model for a given R_p-algebra.

Sheaf.Paper.EtaleFiniteDataDescent is scheme-level descent; Mathlib Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit supplies affine-stage descent; WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Ring.FilteredColimits supplies the principal-localization colimit. No theorem with the unpointed ring-model conclusion was found.

lean.statement:
theorem primeLocalization_etale_algebra_model
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (B : CommRingCat.{u})
    (α : CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ⟶ B)
    (hα : Etale (Spec.map α)) :
    ∃ (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : R ⟶ C) (i : C ⟶ B),
      Etale (Spec.map a) ∧
      a ≫ i = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫ α ∧
      ∃ M : Submonoid C, (letI := i.hom.toAlgebra; IsLocalization M B)
